text:
eve-support: seeing a sudden surge of 403s for several tenants ~10m after the auth rotation went live. Customers reporting bulk API failures and some billing webhooks are failing.
ashwin: acknowledging, I'm on it. which rotation was pushed?
deploy-bot: deployment: auth-keys-rotation v2026-03-17-21 promoted canary->prod (by julian)
ops-oncall: tailing auth-introspect logs now, seeing 403s + cache-miss churn, then introspect returns 500 for ~3s windows. suspect propagations to the JWKS endpoint didn't finish.
maria-sre: are we seeing any unexpected TTLs on signed keys? last rotation had a shorter cache TTL in the rollout config if I recall.
julian: I pushed the rollout with a 60s JWKS TTL override to speed propagation in canary, maybe that didn't flip back for prod. checking rollout params.
eve-support: customers: multiple customer-reports in zendesk referencing token invalid or insufficient_scope. example: tenant-78 had 403s for /generate endpoint.
ops-oncall: quick repro: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/models returns 403; introspect service shows token not found and then 500s when hitting jwks upstream. log snippet: ```
[auth-introspect] ERROR token_lookup failed tenant=tenant-78 err="jwks fetch 502"
[auth-cache] WARN miss tenant=tenant-78 key_id=abc123
[auth-introspect] ERROR upstream jwks error status=502
```
ashwin: ok initial mitigation plan: 1) pause the rotation rollout (stop any further key promotions) 2) rollback prod to previous key set 3) flush auth cache across prod nodes 4) monitor 5xx/403 rates 5) inform customers.
julian: pausing now. rollback started (rolling back auth keys to v2026-03-16-18).
maria-sre: running cache flush command across prod: ```for p in $(kubectl get pods -l app=auth-cache -o name); do kubectl exec $p -- redis-cli FLUSHALL; done``` will also invalidate local in-memory caches via SIGHUP.
ops-oncall: executed cache flush and triggered SIGHUP. starting to see 403 rates drop for tenant-78. analytics show latency spike earlier but that settles now.
customer-ops: notified impacted customers ~15m ago with temporary workaround: reissue tokens and retry later. several customers reported success after retry.
deploy-bot: rollback finished, all prod instances report keys set to v2026-03-16-18.
ashwin: closing loop: please confirm 1) 403s back to baseline 2) no lingering 500s from jwks upstream 3) any billing webhook failures auto-retried.
eve-support: 403s trending down to baseline, a handful of 403s remain but correlated with expired tokens out of band. billing webhooks: queue retries are clearing.
maria-sre: postmortem items: - validate rollout config defaults (TTL not overridden) - add preflight vcheck that JWKS mirrors between canary and prod after promotion - enhance cache-invalidation orchestration for rotations - improve customer communication template for key rotations.
julian: root cause: rollout config accidentally left TTL=60s for prod promotion step which forced rapid cache churn; coupled with intermittent jwks upstream errors produced a propagation window where introspect returned errors and fallback rejected tokens.
ops-oncall: follow-up action: create an automated gate in our CI to sanity-check TTL and JWKS fetch success across regions before promoting rotation.
eve-support: marking incident resolved for now, leaving channel open for any stragglers. :white_check_mark:
